philosophy: GLOBAL OPTIMIZATION PURIST. Greedy pipelines lose because every early hard decision (a thresholded corner, a collapsed pair, a rejected fit) destroys information the later stages needed. The cure is not better thresholds — it is ONE image-level MAP objective in which corners, primitive types, regularity hypotheses, and template substitutions are discrete variables, curve parameters and junction positions are continuous variables, and raster fidelity is a HARD interval constraint rather than a score. Perception = MDL: the most regular, simplest vector explanation that stays inside the sub-pixel evidence tube. Every number in the system is either derived from raster semantics (0.5 px), an MDL bit-cost calibrated once on GT, or a deliberately loose proposal tolerance whose mistakes the exact solver can reject. Deterministic, monotone-energy, fully auditable: for any output you can print which hypotheses fired and what each cost.
method_name: PRISM — Perceptual Raster Interpretation via Structured MAP (joint arrangement / corner / primitive / regularity optimization)
core_idea: Vectorize the WHOLE image as a single planar arrangement whose interfaces are fit exactly once and whose junctions are shared continuous variables — then solve one energy E = corner-evidence + primitive-MDL + soft subpixel fidelity + curvature fairness − regularity rewards, subject to hard ±0.5 px directional interval constraints and hard equality constraints for every activated regularity. Discrete structure (corner on/off per sample, primitive type per span, regularity hypothesis on/off) is solved exactly: a Cornucopia-style joint corner+primitive shortest-cycle DP per interface, then a small ILP (CP-SAT) over regularity hypotheses; continuous geometry is solved by one sparse interval-constrained SQP over all curves and junctions simultaneously. Because a feasible solution always exists inside the interval tube (the crack polyline itself), the pixel-staircase fallback is structurally eliminated, and because regularities are hard equalities gated by feasibility, symmetry is either EXACT or not applied — never approximately smeared. The corner CNN survives only as a per-sample log-odds unary potential; no threshold, no NMS, no collapse window ever makes a decision the DP cannot revisit.
pipeline:
STAGE 0 — Raster semantics (reuse + small fixes). Alpha-composite properly before palette (fixes gap 8). Existing routing: JPEG→native, lossless ≤512px→MiniNet 4x SR, but SR output is used ONLY as segmentation evidence; all geometry is fit at native density (per the bitmap-native finding). compact_palette + ICM Potts + sliver merge + enclosed-counter rescue run as-is to produce the initial labeling L0.

STAGE 1 — Arrangement + subpixel evidence field. Promote paper-regions (Kopf-Lischinski crack graph, region_graph.py) to the ONLY mode; remove the ≥16px-contact gate. Output: planar arrangement with interfaces (open crack chains between two regions) and junctions (valence ≥3 crack nodes). Every interface will be fit ONCE; every junction is one shared 2D variable referenced by all incident curves — seams and junction gaps become unrepresentable. For each crack midpoint m_i compute a subpixel evidence point: along the crack normal n_i, fit the anti-aliased intensity profile (3-tap, using the two adjacent region anchor colors as endpoints) to get offset o_i ∈ [−0.5, 0.5] and confidence w_i = local contrast / noise (JPEG: w_i shrunk by ringing estimate; binary art: o_i = 0, w_i moderate). Evidence tube: curve must pass within [o_i − T, o_i + T] along n_i, T = 0.5 px + ε (hard). This is the ONLY fidelity gate in the whole system.

STAGE 2 — Exact joint corner + primitive DP per interface (replaces threshold→NMS→recenter→collapse→Algorithm-2 entirely). Graph: nodes = (midpoint index i, tangent bin b ∈ 12, corner flag c ∈ {0,1}); edges = candidate primitive spans (i→j, type t ∈ {line, circular arc, clothoid, elliptic arc}) feasible w.r.t. the interval tube (feasibility precomputed with the existing directional-interval / tangent-cone machinery from fit_segment_midpoints; elliptic arc added as a new primitive with 5-param LSQ + tube check — fixes gap 6). Edge cost = MDL(t) + Σ_i∈span w_i·ρ(d_i/σ_i) (soft subpixel residual, Huber ρ). Node cost: c=1 pays −log p_i + β_corner, c=0 pays −log(1−p_i) and additionally enforces G1 between incoming and outgoing tangent bins (G1 violation only possible through a paid corner). p_i is the RAW corner-CNN probability (Platt-calibrated), never thresholded (fixes gap 11); adjacent true corners in small text survive because there is no collapse window — two paid corners simply beat one strained clothoid on evidence (fixes gap 5). MDL costs (bits, calibrated once on the corner-GT + fit harness): line 1u, arc 2u, elliptic arc 3u, clothoid 3u, corner β=4u, with u = α-style scale tied to loop extent as today (32/extent analog). Closed loops: shortest closed cycle (run DP from the flattest node, as now). Interfaces meeting at a junction: junction endpoints are mandatory breakpoints; smooth-vs-corner at the junction is decided later by the global model, so the DP exports both terminal tangent options. Exact, per-interface, milliseconds each, embarrassingly parallel.

STAGE 3 — Regularity hypothesis generation (proposals, deliberately loose: tolerance 2T). The existing Sec-6 regularizers are DEMOTED from mutators to proposal generators, each emitting hypotheses r with (constraint g_r(θ)=0, MDL gain_r, conflict clique): axis-align, image-wide parallelism, orthogonality, shared carriers, co-circular clusters, equal-length, equal-radius; NEW generators: mirror symmetry at ARBITRARY axis (PCA + reflected-Procrustes matching of interface samples), rotation about least-squares center (not centroid), tangency between adjacent primitives, repeated-shape prototypes via arc-length contour matching + Hungarian assignment (no identical-degree-sequence requirement — fixes gap 7), whole-shape templates (rect/rounded-rect/ellipse/superellipse/diamond/regular N-gon; occlusion-completion templates from _complete_occlusions become hypotheses too), glyph hypotheses from font_match. gain_r = bits saved (parameters eliminated + primitives merged) + a small perceptual bonus for symmetry classes.

STAGE 4 — Exact regularity selection: ILP over z_r ∈ {0,1} solved by OR-Tools CP-SAT. Objective: max Σ z_r·gain_r. Constraints: (a) mutual-exclusion cliques (two axes for one edge, two prototypes for one shape); (b) FEASIBILITY: a fast interval-preservation check per hypothesis and per pairwise interaction — a hypothesis set is admissible only if the equality-constrained least-squares projection of the affected curves stays inside every evidence tube (checked by projecting and testing; pairwise + lazy-constraint refinement: if the SQP in stage 5 finds an infeasible active set, add a no-good cut and re-solve CP-SAT — typically 0–2 rounds). Hypothesis counts are O(100) per image; CP-SAT solves in <100 ms. This replaces the sequential snapshot-and-revert regularizer chain with a globally optimal, order-independent selection.

STAGE 5 — One global continuous polish (sparse SQP / augmented-Lagrangian LM). Variables: all junction positions, all curve parameters (line: endpoints; arc: endpoints+sagitta; clothoid: κ0, κ1, L; elliptic arc: 5 params), all shared prototype/template pose parameters. Hard constraints: activated regularity equalities g_r(θ)=0; G1 at every non-corner join; G2 (curvature equality) at every smooth join between curvature-capable primitives — clothoid endpoint drift is absorbed here by the solver instead of linear redistribution, so clothoids stay clothoids (fixes gap 3); interval fidelity linearized per iteration into box constraints (convex QP subproblems, active-set). Soft objective: Σ w_i ρ(d_i/σ_i) + μ ∫(κ′)² ds (fairness, kills wobble) with μ small so evidence dominates. Sparsity: the constraint graph decomposes into connected components (per symmetry group / per letter / per shape); each component is a few hundred variables → total seconds on CPU. Corners placed at analytic support intersections as today, but as constraints inside the solve, not post-hoc.

STAGE 6 — Outer alternation (2 iterations default): render the current vector analytically with anti-aliasing, compare to source; where residual along a boundary is systematically one-sided or a region's mean color error is large, (a) re-estimate region colors by least squares against the source under the AA rendering model (final colors no longer palette anchors — fixes gap 9), (b) flag interfaces whose evidence tube was violated by segmentation error, locally relabel with the current CURVES as the MRF boundary prior, rebuild only affected arrangement pieces, and rerun stages 2–5 there. Accept the iteration iff total E decreases (monotone, terminating, deterministic).

STAGE 7 — Verification is now a proof, not a gate: Hausdorff ≤ T holds BY CONSTRUCTION (hard intervals), so the backstop cannot fire. The only fallback path left: if CP-SAT selection is somehow infeasible, ship the stage-2 DP result (still smooth MDL curves — never a pixel staircase). Emit perceptual metrics per image (circle roundness, max curvature jump at smooth joins ≡ 0, wobble energy ∫(κ′)², seam count ≡ 0) into the harness.
small_images: Tiny loops (≤ ~40 crack edges / ≤18 px² class) skip the DP and go to closed-form template MAP: enumerate parametric templates (square, rect, rounded-rect, circle, ellipse, superellipse, diamond, regular N-gon, teardrop) and optimize each template's continuous pose against the ANTI-ALIASED coverage field of the source (exact area-integral likelihood per pixel, not against the binarized mask) — the anti-aliasing carries subpixel position and size information that binarized fitting throws away, so a 5-px dot becomes a perfectly placed circle with subpixel-correct radius. Selection = likelihood + MDL prior via the same stage-4 ILP, which also lets tiny shapes join image-wide regularity groups (a grid of tiny squares snaps to one prototype + lattice hypothesis, pooling coverage evidence across all instances — repetition acts as super-resolution: n copies give √n noise reduction on the shared prototype). MiniNet SR remains a segmentation aid only; geometry always reads the native AA field. Tiny letter counters survive via the existing enclosed-counter rescue and are fit as templates with the hard interval tube guaranteeing they stay open.
text: Three cooperating mechanisms, all inside the same objective. (1) The stage-2 DP fixes the current text killer: corner recall on small glyphs rises because CNN log-odds trade off exactly against fitting strain — adjacent stem corners 2 px apart are kept when evidence supports them (no collapse window), and the IoU-gate staircase replacement is gone because fallback is structurally eliminated: a glyph is always some MDL-optimal curve chain inside the tube, never 29–86 staircase lines. (2) Prototype pooling: repeated glyphs across a wordmark are detected by arc-length contour matching; each glyph class gets ONE prototype curve chain whose parameters are fit in stage 5 against ALL instances' evidence tubes simultaneously (per-instance translation, shared shape) — an 8-px 'e' appearing 4 times is effectively fit at 4× the evidence. Baseline, cap-height, x-height, stem-width equality, and per-glyph vertical alignment are ordinary regularity hypotheses in the ILP, exact when activated. (3) font_match is promoted from preview to hypothesis generator: a confident word-level match becomes a template hypothesis (font outlines + per-word affine + per-glyph offsets) admitted by the ILP only if the coverage-weighted symmetric difference of every glyph stays within a strict tube-derived bound — so a correct font identification yields perfect type, and an incorrect one is rejected by feasibility, never smearing the letterforms. Failure of (3) degrades gracefully to (1)+(2), which already beat staircases by construction.
symmetry_idealization: Regularity = discrete hypothesis + hard equality constraint + MDL reward, selected globally by CP-SAT and enforced exactly by the SQP. This gives idealization that is EXACT where applied (a mirrored logo is bit-exact mirrored: the solver optimizes one half plus a reflection transform) and BOUNDED everywhere: a hypothesis can only activate if the equality-constrained projection keeps every boundary sample inside its ±0.5 px (+ o_i subpixel offset) evidence tube — the tube IS the accuracy budget, per-sample rather than a global 1–2 px allowance, so idealization can never visibly move geometry. Coverage extends today's set: mirror at arbitrary axis angle, rotation about least-squares center, tangency, equal length/radius, lattices/linear arrays for repeats, whole-shape templates, glyph metrics. Because selection is joint, mutually reinforcing regularities (mirror + orthogonality + equal radii on a shield logo) activate together instead of the first sequential pass eating the budget; because it is order-independent, no snapshot-and-revert heuristics remain. Near-miss regularities in the source (designer sloppiness within the tube) are absorbed — that is precisely the perceptual idealization Hoshyari argues humans do — while genuine asymmetry (outside the tube) is provably preserved.
artifact_elimination: SEAMS: structurally impossible — one arrangement for the whole image, each interface fit once, junctions are single shared variables in the SQP; there is no second copy of any boundary to disagree with, and background is just another region of the arrangement (no white rect showing through). STAIRCASES: doubly eliminated — (a) the interval tube makes a staircase and its ideal line indistinguishable in fidelity, and MDL then always prefers the line; (b) the fallback that shipped staircases cannot fire because the DP over the tube always has a feasible smooth solution (the crack polyline is feasible, so the DP is never infeasible; Hausdorff backstop holds by construction). WOBBLE: the fairness term μ∫(κ′)² ds plus MDL pressure toward fewer primitives removes micro-oscillation; subpixel evidence points (not integer crack midpoints) remove the quantization excitation that causes wobble in the first place. CURVATURE STEPS: hard G2 equality at every smooth join between curvature-capable primitives, solved globally — curvature is continuous by constraint, not by hope; clothoids remain true clothoids because drift is absorbed by the SQP instead of linear point redistribution. WRONG CORNERS (missed or hallucinated): corner decisions are made exactly once, inside the DP, where CNN log-odds compete against measured fitting strain — a hallucinated corner must pay β_corner + (−log p) against zero fitting benefit and loses; a missed corner would force a tube-violating or expensive smooth fit and wins its way back in. No threshold, NMS, or collapse window exists to freeze an error.

new_components.name: Subpixel evidence field
new_components.what: Per crack-midpoint AA-profile fit along the normal using adjacent region anchor colors → offset o_i ∈ [−0.5,0.5] + confidence w_i; JPEG-aware confidence shrinkage. Defines the hard evidence tube used by every later stage.

new_components.name: Joint corner+primitive interface DP
new_components.what: Cornucopia-style exact shortest-path/cycle over (sample, tangent bin, corner flag) nodes with {line, arc, elliptic arc, clothoid} edges, CNN log-odds unaries, MDL edge costs, tube feasibility; replaces threshold→NMS→recenter→collapse→Algorithm-2.

new_components.name: Global interval-constrained SQP polisher
new_components.what: Sparse augmented-Lagrangian LM over all junctions + curve params + prototype poses; hard regularity equalities, G1/G2 join constraints, linearized tube box constraints, fairness term; connected-component decomposition for speed.

new_components.name: Regularity hypothesis ILP (CP-SAT)
new_components.what: Hypothesis schema (constraint, gain, conflict clique), generators refactored from Sec-6 regularizers + new arbitrary-axis mirror / LSQ-center rotation / tangency / lattice generators, feasibility pre-check, lazy no-good cuts from SQP infeasibility.

new_components.name: Tiny-shape template MAP
new_components.what: Closed-form template family fit against the anti-aliased coverage field (exact area integrals), selected through the ILP; handles all ≤18px² loops and joins global regularity groups.

new_components.name: Prototype pooling for repeats and glyphs
new_components.what: Arc-length contour matching + Hungarian assignment → shared prototype curve chains fit jointly against all instances' tubes; glyph-class detection, baseline/x-height hypotheses; font_match template admission with per-glyph symmetric-difference feasibility bound.

new_components.name: Render-compare feedback loop + color re-estimation
new_components.what: Analytic AA render, residual analysis, LSQ region-color re-fit, curve-prior local relabeling, incremental arrangement rebuild, monotone-energy acceptance.

new_components.name: Perceptual metric suite
new_components.what: Circle roundness, curvature-jump-at-joins, wobble energy ∫(κ′)², seam counter, staircase detector — wired into benchmark_stages.py and the blind A/B protocol vs vectorizer.ai.

risks: Solver latency on large/complex images: mitigated by per-interface DP parallelism, connected-component SQP decomposition, and ILP scale O(100) vars — but a pathological poster-size input could exceed interactive budget; needs a complexity router (cap hypothesis count, coarsen tangent bins).

MDL bit-costs and β_corner are the new global knobs; mis-calibration shifts the simplicity/fidelity balance everywhere at once. Mitigation: calibrate once by cross-validated grid on the existing corner-GT + certified-logo harness, then freeze.

CNN probability calibration: log-odds unaries assume calibrated p_i; the current models were trained for thresholding. Platt scaling on the GT layer is mandatory or the DP will systematically over/under-corner.

G2-constrained arc/clothoid/elliptic chains are numerically delicate near degenerate configurations (near-zero curvature, near-straight clothoids); the SQP needs careful parameterization (sagitta, κ0/κ1/L) and trust regions or it will rattle.
Lazy feasibility interplay between CP-SAT and SQP could cycle on adversarial hypothesis sets; bounded by max-3 no-good rounds with deterministic fallback to the smaller hypothesis set.
JPEG noise inflates the evidence tube confidence field wrongly if the ringing estimator is weak → over-idealization on photos-of-logos; the tube half-width may need a JPEG-quality-dependent floor.

Prototype pooling can unify glyphs that are genuinely different (e/c at 6 px); the tube feasibility bound is the defense but at extreme tininess the tube is loose — needs a minimum-evidence rule for unification.
OR-Tools CP-SAT is a new dependency (pip, Windows wheels fine) — team must accept it; a branch-and-bound fallback in pure Python is possible but slower.
Regression risk against the four certified logo gates during the stage-2/4 swaps; every stage gate below runs the full harness before the old path is deleted.
staged_plan: Stage A (arrangement everywhere): remove the ≥16px paper-regions contact gate, add shared junction variables, background-as-region. GATE: zero seam pixels on the 11 real-logo floor set under 4x render diff; all certified IoUs (Mastercard 0.9901, Mobil 0.9849, NBC 0.9855, Lacoste 0.9380) maintained or improved.

Stage B (subpixel evidence field): implement AA-profile offsets + confidence; feed existing fitter as soft weights only. GATE: MAE/RMSE on the IKEA forensic image improves vs current 5.88/14.21; no harness regressions.

Stage C (joint corner+primitive DP): replace the corner post-processing chain and per-segment fitting with the exact DP (elliptic arc included); Platt-calibrate the CNN. GATE: corner event-F1 ≥ 0.80 (from 0.73–0.74) on the GT program; fit_benchmark primitive counts not worse; zero staircase fallbacks fired across the full probe set.

Stage D (global SQP + G2): junction-shared continuous polish with tube constraints and G2 joins. GATE: curvature-jump metric ≡ 0 at all smooth joins; wobble energy down ≥50% on smooth-silhouette probes; Hausdorff ≤ tube everywhere by construction (assert, not measure).

Stage E (regularity ILP): swap sequential Sec-6 regularizers for generation + CP-SAT + lazy feasibility. GATE: certified logos same-or-better IoU with fewer primitives; order-independence test (shuffled hypothesis order → identical output); no tube violations.

Stage F (tiny-template MAP): route ≤40-crack-edge loops through template posterior. GATE: tiny-icon probe set renders ideal shapes (roundness/rectangularity metrics); human spot-check on 30 iconify tiny icons prefers new ≥80%.

Stage G (glyph/prototype pooling + font_match admission): GATE: zero staircase output on the 150k-wordmark sample set (n=200 draw); word-level legibility A/B vs current pipeline ≥70% wins; font_match false-admission rate 0 on a 50-word adversarial set.
Stage H (feedback loop + color LSQ + alpha compositing): GATE: IKEA forensic MAE/RMSE beats vectorizer.ai (4.66/9.95); energy monotonicity asserted on full corpus.
Stage I (head-to-head): 50-image blind A/B (icons, logos, wordmarks, tiny icons stratified) vs vectorizer.ai with 3 judges. GATE: ≥60% preference for PRISM; ship.
why_beats_vai: Vectorizer.ai's forensics show a greedy-then-polish system: everything becomes 0.01px-rounded cubics, hidden layers are completed, letters are redrawn on top — but it has NO explicit regularity model. Its output is approximately symmetric where the input was, approximately circular where the input was; it cannot make a circle exactly round, two stems exactly equal, or a wordmark's four 'e's identical, because nothing in it represents those facts. PRISM represents them as discrete variables and enforces them as exact equalities bounded by a per-sample subpixel evidence tube — so where a human sees intended regularity, we emit mathematically perfect regularity, and where the design is genuinely irregular, feasibility provably blocks idealization. Repetition pooling gives super-resolution VAI cannot match: n instances of a tiny glyph are fit as one prototype against n evidence tubes. Structural guarantees replace VAI's polish: seams unrepresentable, staircases impossible (fallback path deleted, Hausdorff holds by construction), curvature continuous by constraint. And unlike VAI's black box, every activated hypothesis, every corner decision, and the full energy ledger are printable per image — deterministic, debuggable, and gate-tested against the team's existing certified harness. VAI wins today on smoothing everything into plausible cubics; PRISM wins on the thing humans actually judge: idealized, exactly-regular, artifact-free shapes with crisp true corners — including at 16 px.
